ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white central lobes. Continuous low-intensity black perimeter along the trailing edge and center peduncle. High density of discrete, circular low-intensity black spots (5-20 pixel diameters) distributed across the distal regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression, approximately 55-60 degrees, with a deep vertical bounding-box penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge boundary; right lobe exhibits larger amplitude 'sawtooth' jags compared to the left lobe distal edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-curving concave trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial distribution of circular, high-contrast dark rings with light centers across both lobes, with the highest density clusters appearing on the distal outer thirds.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, dark, vertically-oriented curved linear mark on the lower-mid quadrant of the left lobe. Multiple smaller, fainter linear streaks located near the central peduncle area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible three-dimensional, brownish-yellow protrusions (barnacle clusters) attached to the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'ocelli' pigmentation pattern characterized by hundreds of individual circular spots, creating a high-frequency texture map distinct from typical solid-mottling.
